$comment: Least-privilege profiles (core, customer-agnostic). Every role in org.json references exactly one profile. claudeTools = maximum Claude Code tool set an agent file of this profile may declare. connectorCapabilities = abstract capabilities; the customer config maps them to concrete MCP tools. Domain values: no | read-only | branch-only. 'write' is forbidden for prod/finance/deploy in Phase 1 and secrets must be 'no' (enforced by tests/governance.test.ts).

orchestrator.description: Cloud CEO. Plans, delegates, merges results. Orchestration knowledge without production rights.

lead.description: Board lead. Plans and accepts work; runs read-only commands; does not build.

builder.description: Specialist that edits code/tests on a feature branch and opens PRs. No main, no production, no secrets, no gate files.

doc-maintainer.description: Maintains documentation/config under ai-company/ on a branch. No code, no gates, no shell.

reviewer.description: Independent reviewer/auditor. Reads, searches, runs tests and reports. Never edits.

researcher.description: Reads official external sources. No shell, no edits, no purchases.

deploy-verifier.description: Reads deployment status, health checks and logs. Cannot deploy or change configuration.

finance-reader.description: Finance board (Phase 1). Reads accounting data via the accounting connector's read tools only.

operations-reader.description: Daily COO. Reads operational sources (currently only the accounting queue/reconciliation) to build the daily brief.

analyst.description: Planned business roles without connected data sources. Concept and gap analysis only.

office-agent.description: Future customer-facing office agent. Only explicitly granted domain tools; may never modify its own program code.
